title: Iron Legion combat rules (content/rules/combat.json5)
description: Engine tunables read by melee targeting, melee resolution, charges, terrain defence, experience, pursuit and projectiles (Simulation Spec 6 and 15.1). One merged object per enabled mod set; every field is required because the engine carries no numeric defaults.

base_hit.description: Hit probability when attack equals defence (SIM-CMBT-011).

hit_scale.description: Slope of the hit probability in (A - D) / (A + D) (SIM-CMBT-011).

min_hit.description: Lower clamp of the hit probability (SIM-CMBT-011).

max_hit.description: Upper clamp of the hit probability (SIM-CMBT-011).

engage_radius.description: Metres within which a soldier picks a melee target (SIM-CMBT-002).

retarget_period_ticks.description: Ticks between retargeting passes per soldier, staggered by id (SIM-CMBT-002).

reach_slack.description: Metres beyond reach within which a current target is kept (SIM-CMBT-002).

charge_window_ticks.description: Ticks the charge bonus lasts after first contact (SIM-CMBT-015).

charge_dmg_share.description: Share of charge_bonus applied to damage (SIM-CMBT-015).

charge_distance.description: Metres from the target anchor at which an attacking regiment switches to run (SIM-CMBT-004).

charge_mass_mult.description: Mass multiplier of charging soldiers in collision push resolution (SIM-CMBT-015).

brace_integrity.description: Formation integrity needed to brace against cavalry (SIM-CMBT-015).

height_defence.description: Defence bonus at full height advantage (SIM-CMBT-016).

height_range.description: Range bonus at full height advantage (SIM-PROJ-002).

height_ref.description: Metres of height difference that count as full advantage (SIM-CMBT-016, SIM-MOR-017, SIM-VIS-001).

second_rank_reach_bonus.description: Extra reach in metres for second-rank attackers (SIM-CMBT-012).

exp_step.description: Attack and damage multiplier per experience level (SIM-CMBT-017).

pursuit_hit_mult.description: Hit probability multiplier against routing soldiers (SIM-MOR-034).

pursue_repath_ticks.description: Ticks between re-paths toward a pursued regiment (SIM-CMBT-004).

corpse_ticks.description: Ticks a corpse stays drawn; render-only (SIM-CORE-008).

attack_move_radius.description: Metres within which an attack-moving regiment acquires the nearest enemy regiment (SIM-CMBT-005).

projectile_cap.description: Live projectiles above which volleys resolve statistically (SIM-PROJ-008).

projectile_radius.description: Metres added to a soldier's radius for landing hits (SIM-PROJ-006).

scatter_scale.description: Aim scatter as a fraction of distance at zero accuracy (SIM-PROJ-004).

direct_apex.description: Apex height in metres of a direct-fire arc (SIM-PROJ-005).

gravity.description: Metres per second squared for indirect arcs (SIM-PROJ-005).

shield_mult.description: Ranged damage multiplier for a frontal hit on a shielded soldier (SIM-PROJ-006).

stat_hit_base.description: Base hit probability of the statistical projectile path (SIM-PROJ-008).

friendly_block_dist.description: Metres within which a friendly footprint blocks direct fire (SIM-PROJ-009).

volley.description: Synchronise reload phases within a regiment (SIM-PROJ-003).
